draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Kattappana! Settlers from towns like Thodupuzha, Pala and Kanjirapally built this place up in the 1950s, and now it's the second largest town in Idukki district.
draft.hungryLine: I don't have a named spot here yet, so ask around the town centre, it's the commercial hub for the whole area.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Gandhi Square is a 4 min walk, the Amar Jawan War Memorial is about 9 min, and St George Forane Church is around 15 min.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Gandhi Square, just a 4 min walk away, is an easy place to sit and watch the town go by.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Kattappana only became a gram panchayat in 1962, and it waited until 2015 to become a municipality.

tips.title: Dress modestly.
tips.body: There are lots of churches and temples within a short walk of the centre.

tips.title: Use it as a base.
tips.body: Kattappana is the main market town for the area, 32 km from the district headquarters at Painavu.

story.title: The settlers
story.body: People from Thodupuzha, Pala, Kanjirapally, Kothamangalam, Muvattupuzha and Changanassery moved here and formed the town.

story.title: A municipality
story.body: The town became a municipality, one of only two in Idukki district.

story.title: Your turn
story.body: A busy hill market town. Tell me what you found in the bazaar.
